The '''Red War''',{{efn|Somtimes abbreviated as '''RW''' or '''TRW'''}}  (22 May 1688 – 3 December 1695), was a [[Wikipedia:World war|global conflict]] between two [[Wikipedia:Coalition|coalitions]]: the [[Accord]] and the [[Vanguard]]. [[Red War by country|Nearly all of the world's countries]] participated. [[Tanks in the Red War|Tanks]] and [[Air warfare of the Red War|aircraft played major roles]], the latter enabling the [[Wikipedia:Strategic bombing|strategic bombing]] of cities. The Red War was the [[List of wars by death toll|deadliest conflict]] in history, causing the death of 70 - 85 million people. Millions died in [[Wikipedia:Genocide|genocides]], including the something, and by massacres, starvation, and disease. After the Allied victory, [[Allied-occupied Lycroa|Lycroa]], [[Allied-occupied Alzuria|Alzuria]], [[Occupation of Dahe|Dahe]], were occupied, and [[Alzuria (region)|Alzurian]] and [[Lycroa|Lycroan]], [[Ashain]] Leaders were tried for [[Wikipedia:War crime|war crimes]].

The [[causes of the Red War]] included unresolved tensions in the aftermath of the [[Great Imperial War]], and the rise of ______ in Ayuma and nationalisim in Dahe. Key events preceding the war included the [[Alzurian Civil War]], the outbreak of the [[Vayvele Rebellion]] in 1684, and Lycroan Nationalisation of its industries and the [[Dahen invasion of Suenan|Dahen invasion of Suenan in 1686]].

The Red War is generally considered to have begun on 22 May 1688, when the Union of Lycroa, under _____, invaded [[Emara]], after which the Accord, including [[Siana]], [[Easuhura]] and [[Praesyu]] declared war on Emara. [[Praesyu]] was also invaded by the [[Alzurian Union]] in mid-June, and was partitioned between Lycroa and the [[Acrana]] under the _____ Pact. In 1688, Merela Sta annexed the [[Yaxuto]] and [[Palina]] and parts of Siana and Versua, while Lycroa conquered [[Siana]], and [[Ilicuhe]]. In June 1789, [[Dahe]] officially entered the conflict with the [[invasion of Sanagara]], and launched offensives into the [[Emaran colonies]] in [[North Massir]]. The war continued between the Vanguard, now assisted by [[Ashain]], who started an [[invasion of Pelugrotoa]] in October 1689 and the [[Easuhuran Empire]] and [[Versua]] fighting in the North, [[Nasuanian Sea|Nasuanian]], and [[South Acrola]], across all of [[Massir]], the aerial [[Battle of Britain|Battle above Eashura and Emara]], and the land war in [[Ankusano]] and [[Sursa]]. By late-1689, [[Emara]] had been defeated by [[Vanguard]] countries. in Decemebr 1789 New Misos under ____ launced attacks againt Raledrian fortifictions across the border, brining Raledria into the Accord. In April 1690, [[the Vanguard powers]] invaded [[Estijan Huan]], opening the [[Northern Front (Red War)|Northern Front]].

In January 1791, [[Alzuria (region)]] attacked [[Areoix Lie|Arten]] territories across the [[Valmiran Mountains]], leading the [[Areoix Lie]] to enter the war against the Vanguard. [[Ashain]] conquered much of coastal [[Pelugrotoa]] and [[West Quia]]. Dahen's advances in [[North Massir]] were halted in June 1941 at the Battle of III. Fighting Spreads to [[New Ayre]], including the entrance of [[Etirha]] into the Accord. In early 1693, Dahen forces were defeated in [[North Massir]] and at [[Valkirseh]] in [[Verusa]]. An Allied invasion of Praeyu in July 1694 resulted in breaking the land connection between [[Alzuria (Nation)|Alzuria]] and [[Lycroa]], and Accord offensives in the [[Mahea]] and Atirha and the [[Estijan Huan]] forced the Vanguard to retreat on all fronts. In 1694, the [[Accord]] invaded [[Dahe]] at [[Jiharao]], and the Huan advanced into [[Alzuria (Region)|Alzuria]]. During the same period, Ashain suffered major setbacks, including the crippling of its navy by the [[Raledria]] and [[Easuhura]], the loss of key [[Hinsakian Ocean|Hinsakian]] islands, and defeats in [[Hijita]] and [[Pelugrotoa]].

The war in Ayuma concluded with the liberation of [[Lycroan-occupied territories|Lycroan]] and [[Alzurian-occupied territories]] and the [[Huan invasion of Lycroa|invasion of Lycroa]] by the Accord, which culminated in the fall of Jungui to [[Estijan Huan|Huan]] troops, and Lycroa's and Alzuria's unconditional surrender on the 3rd of December. The Red War transformed the political, economic, and social structures of the world and established the foundation of international relations for the rest of the 16th century and into the modern 17th century. The Estijan Huan and the Raledria emerged as rival [[Wikipedia:Superpower|superpowers]], setting the stage for the [[Cold War]], with [[Dahe]] joining their ranks fifteen years after the end of the war. In the wake of the world's devastation, the influence of its great powers waned, triggering the [[Wikipedia:Decolonisation|decolonisation]].
